title: Typing in the Customer filter lists matching customers by contains match, with checkmarks on selected ones
permissions_required: Sales By Customer report View permission.
preconditions: 1. You are on the Sales By Customer report.
2. At least two customers with distinct names have invoices in the current date range/Product Type/location (seed ZZAUTOTEST customers if needed).
steps: 1. Open the Customer filter and type a fragment from the MIDDLE of a customer's name, in different letter case (for example type "corp" for "Acme Corp").
2. Read the list of customers shown.
3. Click one listed customer to select it and look at its row in the dropdown.
expected: 1. As you type, customers whose names contain the typed text appear in the list — matching is case-insensitive and matches anywhere in the name (a "contains" match, not starts-with).
2. The list is scoped to the active date range, Product Type, and location.
3. A selected customer is shown with a checkmark.
design_ref: none - SPEC-ONLY (Report Suite has no designs yet)
notes: The server-fetch aspect of the type-ahead is covered by SBC-API-03; this case verifies the visible matching behavior only. BUILD-DELTA: the server-backed type-ahead is the 2026-07-21 committed target (spec ahead of code by design) — the current build may still load a full client-side list at VIU.
